records.question: average speed per vessel
records.deltaText:
-- view: table
SELECT vessel, AVG(speed) AS avg_speed FROM telemetry GROUP BY vessel ORDER BY vessel
records.sql:
-- view: table
SELECT vessel, AVG(speed) AS avg_speed FROM telemetry GROUP BY vessel ORDER BY vessel

records.question: hourly average wind speed over the last 2 days
records.deltaText:
-- view: line
SELECT date_trunc('hour', ts) AS hour, AVG(wind) AS avg_wind_speed FROM telemetry WHERE ts >= '2026-09-14 23:59:54'::timestamp - INTERVAL '2 day' GROUP BY hour ORDER BY hour
records.sql:
-- view: line
SELECT date_trunc('hour', ts) AS hour, AVG(wind) AS avg_wind_speed FROM telemetry WHERE ts >= '2026-09-14 23:59:54'::timestamp - INTERVAL '2 day' GROUP BY hour ORDER BY hour

records.question: max wave height per vessel per day
records.deltaText:

records.question: compare speed of Kestrel and Nomad by hour
records.deltaText:
-- view: line
SELECT CAST(strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:00:00', ts) AS TIMESTAMP) AS hour, vessel, AVG(speed) AS avg_speed FROM telemetry WHERE vessel IN ('Kestrel', 'Nomad') GROUP BY hour, vessel ORDER BY hour, vessel
records.sql:
-- view: line
SELECT CAST(strftime('%Y-%m-%d %H:00:00', ts) AS TIMESTAMP) AS hour, vessel, AVG(speed) AS avg_speed FROM telemetry WHERE vessel IN ('Kestrel', 'Nomad') GROUP BY hour, vessel ORDER BY hour, vessel

records.question: where was Meridian yesterday
records.deltaText:
-- view: table
SELECT
  lat,
  lon
FROM
  telemetry
WHERE
  vessel = 'Meridian' AND ts >= '2026-09-14 00:00:00' AND ts < '2026-09-15 00:00:00'
ORDER BY
  ts DESC
LIMIT
  1
